name: GitHub Release Monitor
author: irhop
description: Watches the projects you depend on and tells you when one ships — or when one has gone quiet for longer than it usually does.

barWidget.description: New releases from the repositories you track, and a warning for any that are past their own release cadence. Needs no GitHub account.

schema.label: Overdue after
schema.description: Multiples of a repository's own average gap between releases before it counts as overdue. 1.5 means half again as long as usual.

schema.label: Show the number
schema.description: Turn off for an icon that only lights up when something ships
